mark: A live client disconnect aborts the engine request (its 32/32 test); keep-alive frames every 15 s; servebench's streams parse
evidence: README section 3: pytest --noconftest on test_api_cancellation.py, test_request_submission_cleanup.py, test_utility_call_cleanup.py, then bench_sse_keepalive.py (both in CPU containers, no --gpus); patched-file copy-in dropped because the candidate image carries 0767. The bench was also run on 1107, where its candidate_new arm exercises 1107's with_sse_keep_alive. Supplementary (ours): check_972_default_cadence.py resolves the default interval and times frames over a 46 s stall

1107_boot1.note: 1107 has no default interval: keep-alive is off unless --sse-keep-alive-interval is passed

measured.interval: abort and cadence counts are identical across boots; wrapper cost varies by at most 0.04 us/chunk between boots on the candidate

parts.part: client disconnect aborts the engine request (its 32/32 test)
parts.detail: 32/32 completed aborts and 0 leaked load metrics on both candidate-48 boots; the same arm on 1107's code gives 0/32 on both boots. The live disconnect against a serving engine is cannot-evaluate-on-sp8

default resolves to 15.0 s on the image and frames arrive at 15.016 / 30.03 / 45.05 s during a 46 s stall on both boots (supplementary check, ours); the PR's 20 ms cadence bench gives 3 frames at about 20.1-20.9 ms. Not checked through a live server
needs servebench against a live server; the pytest suite's OpenAI SDK SSE parser compatibility test passes (part of the 71)

verdict_scope: sp8-evaluable parts only; the live disconnect and servebench parts are cannot-evaluate-on-sp8
reason: The PR's tests pass 71/71 on both boots, its 32-trial disconnect test completes 32/32 aborts on the candidate image and 0/32 on 1107's code, and the image's default keep-alive cadence is 15 s. The bench's candidate_new arm wraps a fake generator whose cleanup is itself shielded; that stands in for the patched AsyncLLM.abort, so the 32/32 is an ASGI-level result, not an engine-level one.
notes: commands.txt start_utc is when the command was issued and includes any wait on /tmp/spark-lab-gpu.lock
The 1107 arm of the supplementary check stops at resolution because 1107 has no get_sse_keep_alive_interval
